metrics.label: Tests (full suite, machine-pinned)
metrics.note: Pass count of the last green `npm test`; the suite asserts this number.

metrics.label: Boundary audit — files scanned
metrics.note: Tracked files from `git ls-files` (ignored trees such as var/ are not counted).

metrics.label: Boundary audit — violations
metrics.note: Zero is enforced by `npm run boundary:audit`.

metrics.label: Docs contract — commands executed
metrics.note: Documented node/npm commands that actually run in the docs harness.

metrics.label: Docs contract — skip-listed
metrics.note: Each skip has a named, still-true reason; unclassified commands fail the contract.

metrics.label: Docs contract — docs covered
metrics.note: Documents that contributed at least one executed command.

metrics.label: Commits ahead of v0.6.0
metrics.note: History depth, not a quality signal.

nonClaims: These are measurements of this repository at the commit above — not customers, revenue, adoption, or unique users.
A green test count proves the tests pass; it is not a security audit, certification, or production-readiness claim.
Boundary counts cover tracked files only; generated and ignored trees are excluded by design.
No third-party registry or download figures are included here, because this script performs no network calls.
